q: The joint communiqué of the November 2026 Security Consultative Meeting (SCM) explicitly states that USFK will be maintained at 28,500 troops
basis: The joint communiqués of 2019, 2021, 2023, and 2024 pledged to maintain U.S. forces in Korea at their "current level" without giving a number; the 2020 communiqué left the phrase out, and the 57th communiqué, in November 2025, dropped even the words "current level." The 2026 National Defense Strategy spells out South Korea's primary responsibility.
rs: The text of the 2026 ROK-U.S. Security Consultative Meeting joint communiqué (as posted by the South Korean and U.S. defense ministries)
